intent: Environment-connection revision; proposed crystal-vault representation of original castle
prompt:
Edit the supplied Facet TD hybrid voxel-cave screenshot. Keep the gameplay HUD, grey palette, isometric orthographic camera, board dimensions, grid, all three gems and the exact checkpoint labels/positions/order unchanged. This is a precise ENVIRONMENT CONNECTION revision of the reference, not a new map or new UI.

MAIN CHANGE: the playable arena must be part of continuous cave floor, NOT a floating platform or isolated island above a chasm. Keep the same board shape and projection but embed its edges flush within the surrounding stone. Eliminate the deep void moat around the arena. There must be TWO unmistakable functional environment connections:
1. ENTRANCE at the board's logical TOP-LEFT / northwest START corner. In this isometric projection that corner is near the upper apex and the S marker. Put a dark carved cave tunnel mouth in the surrounding rock just beyond that corner, with a low clear stone approach that enters the board and feeds directly to the existing S marker. Use a shadowy opening, irregular voxel rock arch and a few subdued amber lanterns. Do not put the entrance beside checkpoint 1 or 4; connect it to S.
2. DEFENDED GOAL at the logical BOTTOM-RIGHT / southeast EXIT corner. In this projection that is the lower apex and the E marker. Beyond that board corner, extend the stone approach into a fortified CRYSTAL VAULT embedded in the cave rock. Show a sturdy grey stone gatehouse with an open visual glimpse of one protected pale blue-white faceted heart crystal behind a reinforced gate. This is the cave-themed visual representation of the original castle. It must look like a place enemies are trying to breach, not a hostile portal they emerge from. Connect the existing E marker continuously to the vault gate. Keep the gate and crystal outside playable grid cells, clear of the bottom-right toolstrip and the bottom-left selection panel.

ENVIRONMENT: modest grey voxel rock ledges with clean faceted colored mineral outcrops; original hybrid style. Three small playable gems retain crisp non-voxel facets. A continuous walkable-looking stone apron ties the board to both rock walls. No bridges over voids, no floating tiles, no lava, no vegetation, no added monster units. Use subtle warm lights at the entrance and restrained pale cool light inside the defended vault, while the UI remains grey. The board stays brightest and most readable.

STRUCTURAL LOCK: preserve all existing S,1,2,3,4,5,E markers. Do not add a checkpoint 6, do not renumber or reorder. Preserve the dashed route and four low wall arms with their openings. Keep top-left five-slot placement summary, bottom-left selected ruby panel, bottom-right icon-only toolstrip and top status bar. Do not add explanatory overlays, captions, labels, posters or insets. Exactly one landscape gameplay mockup, same aspect and framing. High-quality plausible browser-game 3D render; no depth-of-field or bloom.
